info.title: FLEXON CLI
info.description: Secure cross-platform CLI for the FLEXON v2 binary format.

commands.name: decode
commands.description: Convert one FLEXON value to JSON

commands.name: decrypt
commands.description: Remove authenticated encryption from a FLEXON file

commands.name: encode
commands.description: Convert one JSON value to FLEXON v2

commands.name: encrypt
commands.description: Rewrap a FLEXON file with authenticated encryption

commands.name: keygen
commands.description: Generate an ECDSA P-256 signing key pair

commands.name: serialize
commands.description:
Package one or more files into FLEXON v2
deserialize Safely extract a FLEXON package

commands.name: sign
commands.description:
Create a detached signature for a file
verify-signature Verify a detached file signature

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate FLEXON contents against a JSON schema subset

options.name: --password-env
options.description: Read password from an environment variable

options.name: --password-file
options.description: Read password from a protected local file
